storage.heading: Notes storage
storage.description: Notes are kept in the app's data folder by workspace location. Removing a workspace keeps its notes.
storage.orphanHint: Add the same folder as a workspace to see these notes again.

voiceMemory.modelUnavailable: The voice print model is unavailable on this computer.

settings.title: Remembered voices
settings.description: Voiceprints for people you've named · encrypted and stored on this computer only

consent.title: Remember voices?
consent.description: When you name someone, this computer encrypts and stores their voice characteristics to suggest their name in future recordings. This includes other meeting participants, so let them know when appropriate. Voice memory makes no extra copy of the original audio.
consent.hint: You'll only be asked once. You can change this or delete voices in Settings › Notes.
